summary_md: **Alex Loth | Dev & Author ([@xlth](https://x.com/xlth/status/2115354329024786445))** put **CRED-1** in the official MCP registry: check_domain and batch_check over 2,672 scored domains so an agent can flag known misinformation sites before citing them; runs locally and refreshes weekly.

referenced_urls.title: GitHub - aloth/cred-1: CRED-1: Open, reproducible domain credibility dataset for automated pre-bunking of online misinformation. TypeScript library, CLI & MCP server. Check any news source's reliability from terminal, code, or AI agents. CC BY 4.0, DOI-citable.

relevance: A local credibility check tool for research agents via MCP.

media.description: Terminal-style card for the CRED-1 MCP server: running it with npx, its tools (check_domain, batch_check, search_domains, get_stats, get_categories) and a sample check_domain result scoring a site as low-credibility 'fake'.
media.ocr_text:
CRED-1 MCP server
now in the official MCP registry
$ npx -y @aloth/cred1 --mcp
tools: check_domain batch_check search_domains get_stats get_categories
> check_domain("infowars.com")
{ "score": 0.139, "category": "fake", "level": "low", "sources": 2, "domainAge": 27.6, "trancoRank": 22784 }
2,672 domains | data bundled, runs locally | weekly snapshots | github.com/aloth/cred-1
